data.raw_text:
In Church News Today this Wednesday, Nov. 19:

The First Presidency of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints announced today that in an effort to emphasize the morning and afternoon sessions of general conference, Saturday evening sessions will be discontinued, beginning in April 2026. Read more about this announcement at https://t.co/B1pkIb5smK or on the Church News app.

Brigham Young University President C. Shane Reese and BYU Advancement Vice President Keith Vorkink joined the Church News podcast to speak of the university’s 150th anniversary and the sesquicentennial theme of “Celebrating Gifts of Light.”

After two typhoons swept across the Philippines within days of each other and resulted in more than 230 fatalities, the Church of Jesus Christ is working to provide aid for nearly 50,000 people. The Church opened the doors of more than 240 meetinghouses to those seeking refuge or those displaced by flooding.
